question: Should Android expose global skill enable/disable and ClawHub skill installation through the existing Gateway admin boundary plus the new explicit pre-install verdict lookup?
rationale: The patch keeps enforcement in Gateway, but it expands a mobile client into executable skill installation and a new verdict lookup shape, which is a maintainer product/security posture choice rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Accept after complete proof
options.body: Proceed if maintainers accept the boundary and the contributor adds redacted current-head Android proof for admin gating, toggles, successful install, and blocked or acknowledgement-required install behavior.

options.title: Limit to installed skills
options.body: Keep Android installed-skill search/filtering and admin-gated enable/disable while removing ClawHub install and explicit verdict lookup from this PR.

options.title: Keep installs web-only
options.body: Pause or close this direction if maintainers want ClawHub installation to stay in Control UI until a broader mobile security design is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept after complete proof
recommendation.body: Proceed if maintainers accept the boundary and the contributor adds redacted current-head Android proof for admin gating, toggles, successful install, and blocked or acknowledgement-required install behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for ClawHub install and skill security boundaries points to this person.
